hypotheses.N0_error_is_cancellation_relative: Maximum recomposition error relative to the full exact response is at most 1e-4 across failures and controls.
hypotheses.N1_head_identity_is_numerically_stable: The dominant head is unchanged when projection shares are defined against the recomposed response for every failure.
hypotheses.N2_localization_strength_is_stable: Across failures, median recomposed-reference top share remains at least 0.50 and effective support remains at most 3.
hypotheses.N3_original_localization_was_numerical_a: Any failure changes dominant head or median effective support exceeds 5 under the recomposed reference.
